ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) ventral surface with approximately 20-25% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution concentrated in linear scars and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) mapped to the medial and upper sections of both lobes; high-intensity focal spots at the distal tips; localized light-grey mottling concentrated near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined U-shaped central depression with a wide aperture and moderate depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary; high-amplitude jagged peaks visible at the left and right tips; secondary irregular serrations across the trailing margin of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer margins tapering into sharp distal tips; symmetrical upward sweep from the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-intensity pixels at the distal tips of both lobes (left and right), consistent with barnacle colonization patterns; scattered white focal points across the dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive sets of parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) primarily oriented vertically and diagonally on the medial-left and medial-right lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pervasive rake mark scarring across both lobes; significant irregular trailing edge wear and distal tip erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct triplet of parallel vertical scars on the upper-mid section of the right lobe.
